name: wake-no-replug
summary: EXPERIMENTAL: after a deep-standby wake, do not re-send the unchanged port configuration to the input front-end (avoids the emulated unplug: HPD drop, PC re-detects the monitor, other monitors blank)

edits.asm: sub_2398F9 movi r3,1 + first half of jal sub_2393BD -> j wnr (0x23999A-0x23999B unused)

notes: Deep-standby wake (PM 0x3AA bits 4:2 == 1) within the first 5 s: the per-port configuration is recorded as applied without the mailbox update (0x20 sub 12/14/0, 0x60 sub 2) that made the input front-end drop HPD for ~0.2 s. Power-key and mains starts, and later changes, take the vendor path. Uses the cave 0x203FB8 that the current diag-log also uses: build it without diag-log. Generated by tools/patches_src_wake_no_replug.py.
